title: Bar Salts Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Embark on a tropical taste adventure with Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava flavour concentrate. This 30ml bottle delivers a refreshing blend of exotic flavours, combining kiwi's tartness, passion fruit's sweetness, and guava's unique taste to create a vibrant and flavourful e-liquid. Designed for vapers who enjoy crafting their blends, this 100% PG concentrate provides the foundation for a personalized vape experience. Adjust the nicotine level and VG/PG ratios to your liking by adding nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the perfect balance. Mix this concentrate with a VG/PG base of your choice and add nicotine shots as desired to achieve your perfect vape, with recommended dilution rates between 15-20% to suit your taste. Produced in the UK, this high-quality concentrate is designed for optimal flavour accuracy and mixing versatility. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
